subject: mt-info
title: MT.INFO.------CRTF.PROG.
description: Second diagram on page 492 (MP(II)-10). The crossing diagrams how multi-information structurally meets cross-transfer-progressionalism: MT-INFO (multi-information) crossed with CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism). MT-INFO sits on the right with the subject-arrow; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) rises from the main line, AF-TF (affinity transfer) branches from it to the upper-right, and SI (source initiation) branches from the AF-TF line on the right margin. (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation) runs down from the main line; PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) branches from the INTR line to the right, and ATTN (attraction) from the PROJ-DY line. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) runs down from the main line toward its left end; RE-DOC (redocumentation) and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) branch from the PROG-CONT line, and SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) branches from the RE-DOC line at the left margin. Structural argument: when multi-information is crossed with cross-transfer-progressionalism, the upper diagonal T-C-IMP → AF-TF → SI is the *source-initiation route* — time-continuum-implications routes through affinity-transfer into source-initiation, the subject's own forward chain.
